content_zh:
第46章 MV面试与画心-《华娱2008：从分手快乐开始》

上一章

存书签

下一章

橙天娱乐，某个办公室。

“MV女主角？”

“对，这是李晓璐介绍，你要不要去试试？”

听闻此言，糖嫣惊讶地看着自己的经纪人。

见到对方有些犹豫，满脑子都是高片酬的经纪人马上劝道：“你6月下旬才会进组《风云2》，反正这段时间又没事，闲着也是闲着。”

“再说了，拍个MV能花多少时间，他们给的片酬可不少。”

听到片酬两字，糖嫣心动了，她资源一般，有很多地方需要用到钱。

“《体面》这首歌最近很火，出演MV女主角对你有好处。”

“好的，我答应。”

说起这首歌，她还没有听过，打算回去试试。

........

第二天，魏沐收到李晓璐发过来的短信。

没想到对方真推荐过来一个女生。

“人家可是橙天娱乐的重点培养对象，形象符合你的要求。”

“好嘞，谢谢姐，下次请你吃饭。”

“好啊，就我们俩。”

挂断电话，耳边回荡着嫂子璐那句暧昧的调笑。

欠人家一个人情，总要还上。

现在不是2017年，李晓璐风评不错，不论奖项还是人气都是同年龄段佼佼者。

金马影后的含金量不是盖的。

要不是后来“璐出贾笑”，就是奔着老艺术家去的。

两天以后，选角开始。

这次的选角工作主要面向京城地区的表演院校。

太合麦田是国内顶级音乐制作公司，冲着公司名气，来了不少在校学生，甚至有一些小明星。

上百位面试者，让魏老板挑花了眼。

临近下午结束，糖嫣出现。

她跟着助理一起过来。

看着陆陆续续离开的候选者，她心里打起了鼓。

小助理赶忙安慰。

“糖嫣姐，你不用担心，徐姐不是说了吗，就是走个过场，他们那边都安排好了。”

“我知道。”

说是这样说，可她就是不喜欢这种面试的感觉。

这种不确定感，让她有点心慌。

等了没一会，叫到她的名字。

推开门走进去，房间面积很大，对面摆着一张长条桌子，一共坐了五个人。

刚进去，她的注意力就被中间的年轻人吸引。

男人戴着一副眼镜，气质出众，眼睛很好看。

看到帅哥，糖嫣一下子心安。

魏沐推了推闷骚的金边眼镜，从下到上打量着这位“中戏之耻”

Chengtian Entertainment, a certain office.

"MV heroine?"

"Yes, this is Li Xiaolu's introduction. Do you want to try it?"

Hearing this, Tang Yan looked at her agent in surprise.

Seeing that the other party was a little hesitant, the agent, who was thinking about the high salary, immediately advised: "You will not join the cast of "Wind and Cloud 2" until late June. Anyway, you have nothing to do during this time, so if you are idle, you will be idle."

"Besides, it takes as long as it takes to shoot a MV, and the remuneration they give is quite large."

Tang Yan was moved when she heard the word remuneration. She had average resources and there were many places where she needed money.

"The song "Decent" is very popular recently. It will be good for you to be the heroine in the MV."

"Okay, I agree."

Speaking of this song, she has not heard it yet and plans to go back and give it a try.

........

The next day, Wei Mu received a text message from Li Xiaolu.

Unexpectedly, the other party actually recommended a girl.

"I am a key training target of Chengtian Entertainment, and my image meets your requirements."

"Okay, thank you sister, I'll treat you to dinner next time."

"Okay, just the two of us."

After hanging up the phone, sister-in-law Lu's ambiguous teasing words echoed in my ears.

If you owe someone a favor, you must pay it back.

This is not 2017. Li Xiaolu has a good reputation and is among the best in her age group in terms of awards and popularity.

The gold content of the Golden Horse Actress cannot be overshadowed.

If it weren't for "Lu came out of Jia Xiao" later, she would have gone to the old artist.

Two days later, casting began.

This casting call is mainly for acting schools in the Beijing area.

Taihe Maitian is the top music production company in the country. Due to the company's reputation, many school students and even some small stars have come to the company.

With hundreds of interviewers, Boss Wei was spoiled for choice.

Towards the end of the afternoon, Tang Yan appeared.

She came with the assistant.

Seeing the candidates leaving one after another, she felt a drumbeat in her heart.

The assistant quickly comforted him.

"Sister Tang Yan, don't worry. Didn't Sister Xu say it's just a formality? They've already arranged it."

"I know."

She said that, but she just didn't like the feeling of this kind of interview.

This sense of uncertainty made her a little flustered.

After waiting for a while, her name was called.

Opening the door and walking in, the room was very large, with a long table opposite, with a total of five people sitting there.

As soon as she entered, her attention was attracted by the young man in the middle.

The man wears a pair of glasses, has an outstanding temperament, and has beautiful eyes.

Seeing the handsome guy, Tang Yan suddenly felt at ease.

Wei Mu pushed up his dull gold-rimmed glasses and looked at this "shame in the drama" from bottom to top.
